question: Two pipes can fill a cistern, individually, in 44 min and 84 min, respectively. There is a pipe located at the bottom of the cistern to empty it. If all the three pipes are opened simultaneously, then the empty cistern gets filled in 28 min. How long will the pipe at the bottom of the cistern take to empty the completely filled cistern if no other pipe is then open?
solution:
**Given:**

Pipe A fills the tank in 44 minutes

Pipe B fills the tank in 84 minutes

All three pipes together fill the tank in 28 minutes

**Formula used:**

Work per minute = 1 ÷ Time

Total effective rate: A + B − C = 1 ÷ 28
